youtube.title: Why You've Never Seen a Full Rainbow Circle 🌈 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A rainbow is made when sunlight reflects inside raindrops and returns toward the sun, forming a circle around the point opposite the sun. From the ground the horizon cuts off the lower part, so we only see an arc. From a plane or mountain, with raindrops below you, the full circle can appear.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
